title: Salts of Hill Giant Fingernails
summary: Alchemy extract used to make Elixir of Hill Giant Strength.

fields.Recipe: Combine these salts with any Suspension to make Elixir of Hill Giant Strength.
fields.Result: Sets Strength to 21 until Long Rest.
fields.Base value: 30 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
